capabilities.description: Validate rack-level GPU readiness/utilization, temperature, coolant, power, network, error-rate, queue, and useful token telemetry with fail-closed numeric/domain constraints.
Turn telemetry into distinct HOLD/SCALE/DRAIN/THERMAL/POWER/NETWORK actions under explicit infrastructure envelopes.
Estimate safe additional useful-token capacity from readiness, utilization, power headroom, thermal headroom, and reserve policy rather than GPU utilization alone.
Rank safe racks by useful tokens per kW, allocate a requested token rate without using unsafe capacity, and refuse impossible targets with explicit unmet demand.
Apply repeated telemetry safely with emergency override, confirmation hysteresis, cooldown, materiality thresholds, stable allocation state, and deterministic serialized control memory.
Run one complete rack-fleet allocation from JSON telemetry/envelope input and emit a machine-readable allow/refuse receipt.
Replace or redirect the historical scaffold entrypoint so the repository has one authoritative mechanism surface instead of a working controller beside a dead scaffold.
Install the real controller/loop/CLI as the repository package without scaffold metadata or relying on PYTHONPATH-only execution.
Make README and implementation instructions describe the working controller and its actual non-affiliation/reference boundaries rather than a scaffold state.
Translate a real open telemetry surface such as Prometheus/OpenTelemetry measurements into the rack telemetry contract without proprietary Crusoe APIs.
